title: Round Trivet
description: A thicker flat circle that builds on coaster skills and gives you a more useful finished size.
expectationText: A sturdy flat round where you practice even increases for longer without the project getting repetitive too fast.

steps.title: Make the center ring
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring or chain 4 and join into a loop.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 8 single crochet into the ring and join with a slip stitch.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Work 2 single crochet into each stitch around for 16 stitches total.

steps.title: Rounds 3 to 5
steps.instruction: Increase evenly each round by spacing out 2 single crochet in one stitch so the circle stays flat.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Slip stitch to join, fasten off, and weave in the end securely.
